svg.title: Media Transport Library architecture
svg.desc: Applications connect to the Media Transport Library through Frames, RTP Passthrough and Datagram interfaces. The library holds the Pipeline API, Color Format Conversion, ST 2110 sessions, Control Plane Protocols, Management and the Device Abstraction Layer. It runs on the DPDK PMD or the Linux kernel through AF_XDP, on Linux and Windows, with Intel NIC and DMA hardware.
